name: Anchanto WMS (Wareo3)
_comment: Anchanto's own WMS product, Wareo3 -- the API JPluger's wms3 area calls, via connector/wms3-connector and ${WMS_3_URL} (wms-api.anchanto.com in prod). This is NOT the OMS Open API. Reference: docs/anchanto-wms-api.md.
_comment_suites: Only what is written here can be started from /test; the browser sends a suite id, never a command. Paths resolve relative to local-test-servers.

test_suites.name: Mock smoke suite
test_suites.description: All 27 operations, the OAuth2 grant and refresh, every steering marker, the PUT-only product update, and the store write contracts. Drives the mock alone -- no app, no database, no Kafka -- so a red row is the mock or the spec, never an integration.

options.label: Keep state — do not reset the stores or the call log first

token_grants._comment: Every /oauth/token call, with the grant_type as sent. The initial grant carries no body (basic auth), the refresh grant does -- this file is how you tell them apart.

created_orders._comment: Order numbers accepted, b2c and b2b/sto.

order_pushes._comment: Every order-lifecycle write, tagged with its kind, and each recording the warehouse-code HEADER so a test can prove it was sent.

product_pushes._comment: Product create/update/change_status, recording length_cm and weight_gm to prove the unit-suffixed dimension fields arrived.

party_pushes._comment: Supplier and buyer writes. supplier_type_present shows the shared Wms3PartyDataDTO leaking a supplier field onto buyer payloads.

consignment_pushes._comment: Consignment creates with their item lists.

routes._comment: THE live auth mechanism. Serves the initial basic-auth grant AND the refresh grant -- Wms3RequestHandler posts to the same URL for both. /rest/v1/tokens/generate is legacy v1 and deliberately absent from this mock: its token is never used for a v2 call, so a mock that answered it would let a broken auth path look healthy.
routes.name: token issued (grant or refresh)

rules._comment: Lets a test drive the refresh path deterministically: ask for a 1-second token and the client must come back.
rules.name: EXPIRE in client_id -- token valid for 1 second
